Every use of `useVisit` in the patient chart repo is listed below, best first. I searched all of Falkon for `useVisit` and read the production call sites in `openmrs-esm-patient-chart`. The other repositories (patient-management, billing, laboratory, core) also use the hook, but they are outside the chart app, so I did not enumerate them.

**Production call sites, most affected first:**

1. `packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/patient-chart/patient-chart.resources.ts`: `usePatientChartPatientAndVisit` calls `useVisit` at line 94 to fetch the active visit when no valid visit context exists. This drives the chart's visit context on entry. The declaration runs past line 94, so the end line is approximate.
2. `packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/visit/visit-prompt/end-visit-dialog.modal.tsx`: `EndVisitDialog` reads `activeVisit` and calls `mutate()` after ending a visit.
3. `packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/visit/visit-form/visit-form.workspace.tsx`: `VisitForm` uses `mutate` from `useVisit` to refresh the active visit after a visit starts.
4. `packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/visit/visit-form/exported-visit-form.workspace.tsx`: `activeVisit` and `isLoadingVisit` from `useVisit` at line 135, which the visit form depends on.
5. `packages/esm-patient-banner-app/src/banner-tags/visit-tag.extension.tsx`: `VisitTag` decides whether to show the "Active Visit" banner tag.
6. `packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/patient-banner-tags/visit-attribute-tags.extension.tsx`: `VisitAttributeTags` renders displayable visit attributes from `activeVisit`.
7. `packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/actions-buttons/stop-visit.component.tsx`: `StopVisitOverflowMenuItem` shows the "End active visit" item only when `activeVisit` exists.
8. `packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/actions-buttons/delete-visit.component.tsx`: `DeleteVisitOverflowMenuItem` shows the "Delete active visit" item and passes `activeVisit` to the modal.
9. `packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/visit/revalidation-utils.ts`: `invalidateCurrentVisit` targets the SWR cache keys that `useVisit` reads. It doesn't call the hook, but a change to the hook's cache key shape would break it.
10. `packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/visit/visit-mutations.ts`: imports `useVisit` at line 3 but never calls it in the file, so it is unaffected in practice.

**Tests that mock `useVisit` (they would need updating if its return shape changed):**

- `packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/patient-chart/patient-chart.resources.test.ts`
- `packages/esm-patient-banner-app/src/banner-tags/visit-tag.test.tsx`
